newsitem.title: JAPAN: Uchida Hydraulics bid-only in Tokyo on takeover.
newsitem.headline: Uchida Hydraulics bid-only in Tokyo on takeover.

text.p: Shares in Uchida Hydraulics Co Ltd were bid-only in early Tokyo trading on Wednesday on Tuesday's news that a Mannesmann AG wholly owned unit will raise its stake in Uchida to over 50 percent.
As of 0106 GMT, the shares were bid-only at 620 yen, compared with the Tuesday close of 590.
Uchida announced on Tuesday that it would issue 10.9 million new shares in July and allocate all of the shares to Mannesmann Rexroth GmbH of Germany.
As a result, the German company would raise its stake in the Japanese maker of hydraulic equipment to 50.535 percent from the current 25 percent, Uchida said.
The funds raised from the new share issuance, estimated to be worth 4.7 billion yen, will be used to boost the efficiency of production facilities, Uchida said in a statement.
